Package hkust.marketplace.data

Class SeedData

java.lang.Object
hkust.marketplace.data.SeedData
public final class SeedData extends Object
Demo data loaded on the first run so every screen has something to show.
  • Admin: admin / Admin1234 (seeded; there is no admin registration)
  • Sellers: alice_w / Seller123, bob_c / Seller123
  • Buyers: demo_buyer / Buyer123, chris_l / Buyer123
